definition: בָּאְשָׁה noun feminine (stinking things) stinking or noxious weeds , Job 31:40 תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֺחַ וְתַחַתֿ שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה instead of wheat may there spring forth bramble, and instead of barley stinking weeds (compare Assyrian bîšu Zehnpf BAS i. 633 ).
